rows.text: The End Point Protection Solution Public Tender on Revenue Share Basis

To launch a public tender on a revenue sharing basis for an Endpoint protection solution including licenses, implementation , integration, training maintenance and support for MIC2 prepaid and postpaid customers

launch a public tender on a revenue sharing basis for an Endpoint protection solution including licenses, implementation , integration, training maintenance and support for MIC2 prepaid and postpaid customers

The selected supplier must offer cybersecurity services to B2C and B2B customers through a revenue sharing model. The solution must provide multi-platform endpoint security, threat detection, centralized management, and reporting capabilities, with vendors evaluated on technical and commercial criteria.
